description: Audur is a LabVIEW platform from ALSETLab for prototyping synchrophasor-based wide-area control of electric power systems. The repository contains empty controller templates plus examples for phasor oscillation damping and active-load control. Users connect a PMU data stream through S3DK or Khorjin, implement a control algorithm and produce signals for a National Instruments cRIO controller. Coverage and temporal resolution follow the connected PMUs and test setup; the package contains no fixed grid map or historical period. Its templates and guides are public under GPL-3.0, so the project code is free to obtain. LabVIEW Real-Time, LabVIEW FPGA and NI hardware are separate requirements with unverified terms and cost. Audur can support simulated or hardware-in-the-loop studies of grid stability and resilience. A limitation is that a template or lab demonstration does not establish suitability for operation on a live transmission system. No related catalogue record was identified. No controller, PMU connection or hardware was configured or run.
name: Audur wide-area control platform
